summary: Phase 3 pSEO (contract templates) tested end-to-end. 19/19 pytest cases pass and Playwright verifies the eSign client-side banner. data-testid='contract-banner-dismiss' present on the dismiss control — good. Recommend adding data-testid on the banner heading + link too for richer e2e selectors (non-blocking).

Sub-sitemap returns exactly 630 entries — matches plan (30 type hubs + 30×20 leaves). Build-time SSG verified by remote 200s on hub/leaf and 404s on invalid slugs (proves dynamicParams=false or notFound() path).
Title de-duplication fix is working: Next.js metadata template '%s | RealProfits' now applied without local titles already including '| RealProfits'. Verified on hub, sub-hub, and leaf.
